results: A shared signed-enumeration theorem proves that strict real ordering, equality of the actual range and L2 displacement from pi*n fix the ENTIRE signed enumeration, including its finite central offset. It reuses the verified ordered-pair L2 uniqueness theorem, with actual singleton multiplicities.

For EVERY real unit-period L2 Miura profile, the complete canonical auxiliary Dirichlet sequence is strictly ordered and satisfies EXACT signed reflection zeta_(-n)=-zeta_n at EVERY index. In particular zeta_0=0 and zeta_n is strictly positive EXACTLY when n>0. Oddness of the independent characteristic and the original L2 normalization prove the central index, rather than assuming it.

For ANY real L2 Miura profile, the actual scalar Dirichlet characteristic is NONZERO at zero Miura energy. Differentiating the exact auxiliary identity chi(z)=z*D(z^2) at zero and using ACTUAL auxiliary simplicity proves that the factor z introduces precisely one extra auxiliary zero. Every scalar zero is strictly above minus the constant in ANY literal real shifted Miura representation.

The COMPLETE scalar Dirichlet characteristic zero set of every real original H-minus-one potential is exactly the squared POSITIVE canonical auxiliary sequence minus the literal real shift, including ALL central scalar energies. That sequence is strictly increasing on the original positive indices n>=1.

An intrinsic FULL positive-index ordered real Dirichlet characteristic sequence is constructed for EVERY real original H-minus-one potential. It exhausts every complex zero, starts at index ONE and counts EXACTLY every scalar analytic multiplicity. Strict-order range uniqueness proves independence of every real Miura lift, including the finite central block, without an assumed common high tail.

The full intrinsic scalar Dirichlet labels satisfy the source literal n-times-L2 asymptotic: (mu_n-(pi*n)^2)/n is in ell2 on positive indices. The inverse-bracket version is also proved. These are the ENTIRE ordered labels, not only a high auxiliary branch with an unspecified central offset.

The ENTIRE intrinsic scalar Dirichlet sequence has the exact free normalization mu_n=(pi*n)^2 at q=0, including its first positive index. For general real original potentials its sufficiently high labels lie in the SAME original Hill gaps, and their midpoint errors are bounded by half those original gaps, including collapsed pairs.

The full real characteristic labels and characteristic are transported to the article ENTIRE original real mean-zero physically period-one H-minus-one distribution domain using the verified raw unit-period extraction. Strict order, complete zero set, global analytic multiplicity count, literal n-times-L2 asymptotic and same-index high-gap location are proved without endpoint membership premises or frequency rescaling.

The EXACT complete original midpoint error tau_n-mu_n is evenly extended to signed indices with zero at zero. One cutoff controls BOTH tails by half the original periodic gap norm. A shared finite-tail domination theorem then transfers arbitrary complex scalar-weight gap membership at EVERY exponent, including infinity, to the COMPLETE actual characteristic-label midpoint sequence, retaining all finite central values.

For EVERY source SpectralWeight, every admissible endpoint order and every original weighted real mean-zero physically period-one distribution, the COMPLETE intrinsic characteristic-label midpoint error belongs to the corresponding original weighted infinity sequence space. This uses the verified full weighted canonical gap theorem and changes NONE of the original distribution smooth-test actions.
